registered_before: any conflict flag was computed; the inventory, kind tags and incompatibility table are committed and this file is committed with them

denominator.note: the slot count was unknown when the design was written and is not a convenient number; it is what the committed inventory established

band.measure: aligned slots carrying at least one conflicting kind pair
band.below_floor_means: the ledger's cross-field matches are cleaner than suspected and this instrument was unnecessary; publish that and lift the suspension
band.above_ceiling_means: the tags or the table are too aggressive rather than the ledger being noise; publish that and the instrument is at fault, not the matcher
band.rationale: cross-field matching aligns quantities from different subjects, so conflicts should be common; but four logic/set-theory groups and at least one geometric group are expected to be genuine transfers, so a count near 77 would indicate the table is over-firing

named_directional_predictions.members: circle circumference, Ohm's law, Newton's second law
named_directional_predictions.why: CIRCUMFERENCE against POTENTIAL and FORCE is a length against a voltage and a force; this is the prediction the v0.14 release blog put in print

named_directional_predictions.groups: the four logic + set-theory groups (idempotent_operation, lattice_absorption, identity_element_law, complement_involution)
named_directional_predictions.why: proposition and set are declared compatible on their merits; Boolean and set algebra are isomorphic and this is the genuine identity the matcher exists to find. If these flag, the table is wrong.
every aligned slot holds a length

named_directional_predictions.members: algebraic topology rank identity, physics velocity addition
named_directional_predictions.why: CHAINRANK against OBJECT_VELOCITY is a cardinality against a velocity

blind_control.run: first, before the kind-based flags are read
blind_control.rule: flag a slot conflicting when its symbol names differ as case-folded strings
blind_control.defeats_the_direction_if: it agrees with the kind-based labelling on 80% or more of slots where every symbol is tagged
blind_control.expectation: it should agree poorly, because almost every cross-field slot holds differently-named symbols whether or not they denote the same quantity; if names alone reproduce the kinds, the tagging bought nothing

corruption_control.rule: permute the kind tags across symbol occurrences and recompute
corruption_control.requirement: the authored tags must flag STRICTLY FEWER conflicts than the mean of 20 permutations
corruption_control.voids_the_result_if: authored tags flag as many or more than chance, which would mean the tags carry no information

non_claims: no unflagged match is asserted to be real
unjudged means nothing and is not a clean bill of health
no accuracy claim about retrieval; no spent question is re-used
nothing is claimed about the ingested corpus, which is excluded
